fields.title: Please confirm that you have read the Terms and Conditions of the Program below.

properties.description:
Partner Perk Program Terms and Conditions: 

a. You must be in good standing with our community to access our perks program 

b. The program will be listed for the duration of 12 months unless otherwise specified or approved and must be renewed yearly or as the perk changes. 

c. It is the partners obligation to renew and update the perk via the perk portal and connect with the partnerships department (partners@milliondollarsellers.com) as needed. 

e. Partners are limited to one perk per year, any updates or changes within the year may cost an extra fee.

 f. We will only include information provided by the partner to protect the privacy of partners' information.

g. Our community member information will not be provided unless the member chooses to do so on their own by signing up for your perk.
